decisions.decision: Use createOpenAI.chat() not () for @ai-sdk/openai v3 with Zhipu
decisions.rationale: v3 defaults to Responses API (/responses); Zhipu only supports Chat Completions (/chat/completions). .chat() forces correct path

decisions.decision: Add WorkflowRow type + unwrap() in frontend API layer
decisions.rationale: Backend returns DB rows with nested definition field; frontend was treating response as WorkflowDefinition directly causing crashes

decisions.decision: Use onConflictDoUpdate for upsertNode instead of findFirst+insert
decisions.rationale: Race condition between findFirst and insert on concurrent status updates; SQL-level UPSERT is atomic

decisions.decision: Added dotenv/config import to backend entry point
decisions.rationale: tsx watch doesn't auto-load .env files; DATABASE_URL was undefined at startup

decisions.decision: Deleted stale .js files shadowing .tsx files in frontend/src
decisions.rationale: Vite resolved old .js files first; GLM-4.7 option was missing from dropdown until .js files removed
